description: Central AI governance policy for all Nifty agent tools. Enforced deterministically at the tool-call boundary in both OpenCode plugin and Copilot MCP server.

rules.reason: Bulk deletion of more than 5 tasks requires manager approval. Use nifty_archive_task for soft-archival instead.
Deleting a workflow status has irreversible side-effects on all tasks in that state. Raise a Nifty task for manual review before removing statuses.
Deleting a milestone detaches all tasks from it. Raise a Nifty task for manual review before removing milestones.

rules._note: Bootstrap gate handles this separately; rule retained for audit-log completeness.
